Info

Defines structural protocol IFlowBarrier for stream execution synchronization barriers.

class scarajectory.core.service.barrier.iflow_barrier.IFlowBarrier(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining stream execution synchronization barrier operations.

It defines:

methods:
set_barrier - Locks synchronization barrier for synchronous command execution.
clear_barrier - Unlocks synchronization barrier.
is_barrier_clear - Checks whether synchronization barrier is unlocked.
reset - Resets barrier to initial unlocked state.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
clear_barrier() → None[source]¶

Unlocks synchronization barrier.

is_barrier_clear() → bool[source]¶

Checks if synchronization barrier is cleared.

Returns:

True if barrier is clear, False otherwise.

reset() → None[source]¶

Resets barrier to initial cleared state.

set_barrier() → None[source]¶

Locks synchronization barrier.
